[ISTS.4.3] **Always document the pattern inline.** A
reviewer skimming such a scenario should not be left
wondering whether the `if (r.status != DS_OK) return 0`
is a partial check. The function header comment names
the pattern: "Either-conforming: rejection at
load OR at pump satisfies the spec." Compact
inline reference is fine; this section is the long-
form explanation.
